profile.headline: Software Developer at Maple Systems, Inc.

positions.title: Technical Support Representative
positions.description: I engage with customers on a variety of support topics related to our HMIs, PLCs, and other IIoT devices.

positions.title: Delivery Driver
positions.description: Delivering weekly orders of fresh fruit using the company van, restocking their apple fridges, and making sure the area around it looks nice and is clean. I also interact with the client while I fulfill these duties in a friendly and engaging manner.

positions.title: Delivery Driver
positions.description: Being the face of the company that the customer sees out in public and at their door. Delivering their order in a fast and responsible fashion.

positions.title: Wait Assistant
positions.description: Employed as a Wait Assistant I helped the Servers around the restaurant cleaning tables, resetting them for the next guests, and making sure the customers have anything that they need.

positions.title: Intern
positions.description: Employed as an intern, I helped in the shop building sets for the current projects they were working on such as the television show Robot Chicken. I did lots of painting of small sized props as well as painting of faux finished floors and walls. I used shop tools such as sanders, dremel tools, as well as several different painting techniques to create small sized props of my own to be used in the show on sets.

positions.title: Delivery Driver
positions.description:
As a driver I do customer service work, both at the front door when I deliver, and at the store
taking orders in person and over the phone. I am trusted with handling cash and working the 
register, as well as listening to customers and taking orders. I have been given the responsibility 
of opening and closing the store. The work involves preparing food, preparing the store for the 
next day business and clean up.

positions.title: Graphic Production Artist
positions.description:
Employed as an intern, then advanced from part-time to full-time employee with this small
startup company. Embodee’s business involves digitizing garments for major sports clothing brands for online shopping. Their software allows for shoppers to enter their 
measurements on the website and receive a generated 3D model of their body on which the 
clothing selected will then be draped. I utilized software such as Photoshop and Softimage XSI to 
aid with initial placement of these garments as well as the digitization.
